node.name: node
node.hint: Install a supported Node.js runtime yourself.

curl.name: curl
curl.hint: Install curl using your operating system package manager.

omp.name: omp
omp.hint: Install the optional OMP harness yourself or explicitly manage its recipe.

scoop.name: scoop
scoop.hint: Install Scoop yourself; DotAi uses reviewed local manifests and never adds a bucket.

npm.name: npm
npm.hint: Install npm with a supported Node.js runtime yourself.

python.name: python
python.hint: Run DotAi with a compatible externally installed Python interpreter.

shasum.name: shasum
shasum.hint: Supply the external SHA-256 utility required for macOS RTK artifacts.

omp-native-update.name: omp-native-update
check: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); from dotai_app.portable import require_native_omp_update; require_native_omp_update()
omp-native-update.hint: Native OMP update requires an active standalone binary, not a manager-routed install. Use explicit install --force to install a separate standalone copy; keep the old managed copy untouched.

macos: set -eu; install_dir="$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ -L "$HOME/.local" ] || [ -L "$install_dir" ] || [ -d "$install_dir/omp" ]; then printf "Refusing redirected standalone OMP destination\n" >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$install_dir"; tmp=$(mktemp -d "$install_dir/.dotai-omp.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install -o "$tmp/install.sh"; PI_INSTALL_DIR="$tmp/bin" sh "$tmp/install.sh" --binary; test -f "$tmp/bin/omp"; mv -f "$tmp/bin/omp" "$install_dir/omp"
linux: set -eu; install_dir="$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ -L "$HOME/.local" ] || [ -L "$install_dir" ] || [ -d "$install_dir/omp" ]; then printf "Refusing redirected standalone OMP destination\n" >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$install_dir"; tmp=$(mktemp -d "$install_dir/.dotai-omp.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install -o "$tmp/install.sh"; PI_INSTALL_DIR="$tmp/bin" sh "$tmp/install.sh" --binary; test -f "$tmp/bin/omp"; mv -f "$tmp/bin/omp" "$install_dir/omp"

set -eu; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64|amd64) target=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl; digest=bc2b8902b0d9c796c82ef45f16ae2307e17757afeca5ee156235a3dc7bda5f89;; arm64|aarch64) target=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu; digest=d1cc49dfa2cd443fc32625444b59fe616b6c80478cca210985118347174dd758;; *) printf "Unsupported RTK architecture
" >&2; exit 1;; esac; install_dir="$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ -L "$HOME/.local" ] || [ -L "$install_dir" ] || [ -d "$install_dir/rtk" ]; then printf "Refusing redirected standalone RTK destination
" >&2; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p "$install_dir"; tmp=$(mktemp -d "$install_dir/.dotai-rtk.XXXXXX"); trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk/releases/download/v0.50.0/rtk-${target}.tar.gz" -o "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz"; printf '%s  %s
' "$digest" "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf "$tmp/rtk.tar.gz" -C "$tmp" rtk; test -f "$tmp/rtk"; test ! -L "$tmp/rtk"; chmod 755 "$tmp/rtk"; mv -f "$tmp/rtk" "$install_dir/rtk"
